caption: Kitchen counter workout no equipment needed: four moves and one chair while dinner cooks itself. Ten minutes you already had, in the room you were already in. Save it for tonight.

voiceover.text: Dinner is in the oven. The timer says 25 minutes.
You only need ten of them, one chair, and the kitchen you are standing in.
Sit-to-stands. Eight reps. Off the chair, no hands, stand tall.
Incline push-ups, hands on the chair. Eight reps, slow and controlled.
Hinge and reach. Ten reps. Hips back, flat back, reach and return.
Seated knee lifts. Ten reps. Sit tall, lift, lower with control.
Repeat the round until the oven calls time. Two rounds is a full session.
Strength that fits inside dinner. What is in your oven tonight? Tell me below.

overlays.text: The timer is your session clock.

oven timer set dinner table evening
